"Create a massive, ultra-realistic open-world game set entirely in Kerala with next-generation high-end graphics. The main character primarily rides a bicycle to navigate through the map. The world must be filled with authentic Kerala vehicles like fully functional auto-rickshaws (autorikshaw), KSRTC buses, local cars, and scooters moving through the traffic. The environment should feature breathtaking high-fidelity visuals of traditional Kerala villages, bustling city streets, misty hills, and coconut-fringed backwaters, all powered by advanced lighting, realistic physics, and highly detailed textures for a cinematic gameplay experience. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-friendly 3D open-world cycling game set in Kerala, with local traffic, villages, hills, backwaters, and cinematic visuals.

## Requirements
- “3D Game, Phone/Tablet”; responsive touch controls and keyboard controls.
- Bicycle is the primary means of travel; include functional-feeling auto-rickshaws, KSRTC buses, local cars, and scooters.
- Kerala-inspired village, city, misty hill, and backwater environments.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained Three.js game in `index.html`, using procedural geometry and materials, with a CDN import for Three.js.
- Added a ride objective with collectible waypoints and a minimap.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the Three.js scene, bicycle/rider, Kerala countryside, roadside houses and palms, tea terraces, backwater, traffic, HUD, minimap, keyboard/touch controls, and collectibles.
- Started a local test server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/ride-final.jpg`; rendered gameplay was verified.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Optionally inspect `index.html` and run additional playability checks; the browser test surfaced a missing `/favicon.ico` 404 and WebGL performance warnings, but gameplay rendered.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/ride-final.jpg`: Latest gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context
